verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show provisioning via console, API, and CLI, quick SSH access with root, and marketing claims of going from signup to training in seconds (paperspace-docs-1,6,10,12,19,24,30). However, independent hands-on community feedback directly contradicts the 'minutes' experience, describing SSH access as 'an uphill battle' with 'very slow internet' making dataset transfer painful, and general product complaints about notebooks being unusable for serious work (paperspace-comm-7, paperspace-comm-6). missing for 10: independent corroboration that provisioning actually completes quickly in practice, resolution of the SSH-access friction reported by users, and evidence of stable performance post-provisioning.
